name: ALLDAMI Site Migration
author: Baris ARAN

sections.description:
ALLDAMI Site Migration is a powerful tool designed to simplify the process of moving, backing up, and cloning WordPress sites. Whether you are migrating from local to live (or vice versa), or moving between domains, this plugin handles the complexity for you.

Key Features:
* One-Click Export: Create a complete backup of your database and files.
* Chunk-Based Upload: Supports unlimited upload sizes by bypassing server limits.
* Secure: Includes token-based authentication and role management for sensitive operations.
* Dry Run Mode: Test your import process without modifying the database to ensure safety.
* Direct DB Import: Optimized database import engine for large datasets.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/alldami-site-migration directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘ALLDAMI Site Migration’ menu to start exporting or importing.
sections.faq:
Does it support large sites?

Yes, the plugin uses chunk-based upload and stream processing to handle large files without timeout issues.

Is it compatible with all hosting providers?

It is designed to work with most standard hosting environments supporting PHP 7.4+.
sections.changelog:
1.0.9

  • Added manual temporary file cleanup option after export.
  • Implemented automated cleanup for stale temporary files (older than 1 hour).
  • Added exclusion rules for node_modules, .git and plugin temp directories to optimize backup size.
  • Fixed version consistency issues.

1.0.8

  • Fixed timeout issues on file restore with auto-retry mechanism.
  • Fixed CSS/JS loading issues on Admin pages.
  • Improved security checks and WPCS compliance.
  • Added Dry Run (Simulation) mode for safe imports.
  • Improved security with dynamic capabilities and token system.
  • Updated plugin name to ALLDAMI Site Migration.

1.0.1

  • Initial release.
